summary: MEDIROM Healthcare Technologies filed a 6-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Nasdaq notification that its American Depositary Shares failed the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) for 31 consecutive business days from August 24 to October 5, 2026. Nasdaq granted 180 calendar days, until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance via a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days. The company separately remains deficient under Rule 5250(c)(1) for its unfiled FY2025 Form 20-F, with an extension to November 11, 2026. Watch potential reverse split or delisting risk.
